Native fortress Justice / Intelligence / Actors renderer

Source images are the two paths configured in data/runtime/native-pe-images.json.
Static native disassembly only; no game process or translator was executed.
Addresses below are RVAs. Classic corresponding renderer instructions are Steam
(reference) minus 0x2440, with matching control flow and field offsets.

Owner:
 reference 0x4769d0..0x4792c7
 classic   0x474590..0x476e87

Entry and mode selection:
- justice +0x420 dirty flag: clear then call refresh 0x46faa0 (classic 0x46d660).
- selected main tab must equal "Intelligence"; otherwise no intelligence body.
- Empty global interrogation vector and all actor/org/plot catalogs selects the
  two complete empty-state sentences:
  "There is no intelligence information yet."
  "If a crime involves a conspiracy, an interrogation may reveal the plot."
- Four subtabs are rendered, each enabled/disabled by its own source catalog:
  mode +0x290 = 0: Interrogations, global +0x24e3938..+0x24e3940
  mode +0x290 = 1: Actors, source +0x248..+0x250 / filtered +0x318..+0x320
  mode +0x290 = 2: Organizations, source +0x260..+0x268 / filtered +0x330..+0x338
  mode +0x290 = 3: Plots, source +0x278..+0x280 / filtered +0x348..+0x350
- mode dispatch is reference 0x4771f7..0x477218.

Actors branch, reference 0x478433..0x4789aa:
- Selected record index justice +0x294; scroll position +0x2c8; drag flag +0x2cc.
- Candidate records are complete pointer entries from filtered +0x318..+0x320.
- Lazy actor card text supplier 0xd1840 is called for selected record at 0x47846e
  and for every visible/iterated record at 0x478542.
- Card title string +0x58 is passed intact to native text draw 0xad9960 at 0x4786c2.
- Counter is decimal(index+1) + "/" + decimal(total); right edge is calculated
  from counter byte length. Selected and other cards have distinct color flags.
- Card body is vector<string*> actor +0x78..+0x80, generated by supplier 0xd1840.
  Every displayed string is passed intact to 0xad9960 at 0x4788ec; the renderer
  does not draw "Associated", ": <name>", and "Organization" as separate fields.
- Unselected cards reserve/display three body rows. Selected cards display and
  reserve max(3, vector_count) rows. With one body string the first row is titleY+2;
  otherwise titleY+1. Card interval is 2+max(3, selected_count_or_3).
- Body and title draws are clipped to viewport Y. They are not internally truncated
  by this actor renderer; names, aliases, organization status, plots and padding
  are supplied as the full body strings from 0xd1840.
- Height = five rows per actor plus the selected extra body rows. Scrollbar branch
  is used only when that content height exceeds viewport height.

Other mode branches present in the same owner, retained in both full asm files:
- Plots reference 0x47721e..0x4777bb: complete card title +0x40, index/total,
  optional "Org: " plus organization string +0x70 when nonempty.
- Organizations reference 0x4777bb..0x478433: supplier 0xd1650; complete title +0x58;
  either organization chart for selected card or "One member" / decimal + " members";
  optional "Selected actor: " plus actor complete name. Chart labels are producer
  strings from organization entries rather than a new renderer grammar.
- Interrogations reference 0x4789aa..0x4791de: selected-report path folds "Prepared by " + report identity +0x28 and
  complete stored report paragraphs +0x110..+0x118 into justice paragraph rows;
  otherwise list title +0x08 and "Officer: " + record +0x28 use viewport width ellipsis;
  no-report branch uses "No interrogation reports.".

Literal catalogue notes:
native-renderer-sources.tsv retains every native RIP-relative text operand,
including interior suffixes read by SIMD copies. Those suffixes are offsets into
complete constants rather than separate language productions. Calls and control
edges are recorded with instruction and target RVAs. The full annotated asm files
retain all rendering, selection, clipping, count, scrolling and mode branches.
Actor body productions are covered separately by the 0xd1840 producer inventory.
